hero.title: What would you like to do today?
hero.sub: Your intelligent advisory companion — pick a mode to get started.

mode.intro: How would you like to start?
mode.sub: Choose an option below and I'll guide you from there

client.title: I have a client situation
client.desc: Tell me about a challenge your client is facing. I'll ask a few questions to understand the context — then recommend the right template(s) in the right order.

discover.title: I want to find something specific
discover.desc: Looking for a template similar to something you know, or one that combines two capabilities? Describe what you have in mind.

plan.title: I want to plan ahead
plan.desc: Tell me where you are in your practice and what you're working towards. I'll help you find the right planning tools and frameworks for your situation.

learn.title: I'm interested in learning more
learn.desc: Want to develop your skills in selling, facilitation, psychology, or positioning? Tell me what you're working on and I'll point you to the right resource.

course.title: I want to build a course
course.desc: Tell me what you want to develop as an advisor. I'll guide you through building a tailored learning program — session by session, at the right pace for you.

firm.title: Team Dashboard
firm.desc: Monitor your team's course enrolments, progress and quiz scores.

profile.title: Your advisor profile
profile.descEmpty: Answer a few questions once — I'll use your background in every recommendation, without asking again.
profile.descSaved: Saved · tap to review or update

questions.advisorRole: What type of advisory practice do you run? For example — accountant delivering business advisory, financial planner, insurance advisor, business coach, or something else.
questions.experience: How long have you been delivering advisory work?
questions.clientDemographic: Describe your average advisory client in terms of staff numbers, industry, years in business, number of branches and annual turnover — but please don't mention names.
questions.enjoyment: What kind of advisory conversations do you enjoy most or feel you do best?
questions.enjoymentBeginner: Outside of compliance, what aspects of your clients' businesses interest you most — or what area of advisory work are you most curious to explore?
questions.clientDemographicBeginner: What kind of clients does your firm mainly work with — in terms of size, industry, and the work they typically bring to you?
questions.technicalStrengths: What areas of advisory work do you find most challenging, or where would you most like to grow your confidence?
questions.technicalStrengthsBeginner: What's your biggest hesitation about starting to offer advisory services — is it knowledge gaps, confidence, knowing how to charge, or something else?
questions.toolsComfort: How comfortable are you using structured tools and frameworks?
questions.notes: Is there anything else about how you work that would help me tailor my recommendations to you?

opening.client:
Great — let's work through this together.

Tell me about your client and the situation you want to address — I'll use that, along with what I already know about you, to find the right template.

**What's the core situation or challenge you're looking to address with this client?**
opening.discover:
Sure — let's find you the right template.

**Tell me what you have in mind. You can describe it by what it does ("something that helps clients understand their cash flow"), by a combination of topics ("strategic planning plus team engagement"), or by a name you half-remember ("something like the Working Capital one"). The more detail you give, the better I can match it.**
opening.plan:
Great — let's think through this together.

Before I point you to the right tool, I want to understand where you are and what you're trying to achieve — the best planning framework depends entirely on your situation.

**What's prompting you to think about planning ahead right now?**
opening.learn:
Great — this is one of the most valuable things you can invest in.

To make sure I point you to the right resource, I want to understand what you're looking to develop and what's driving it.

**What area are you most drawn to working on — winning clients, facilitation skills, the psychology side, positioning and messaging, or something else?**
opening.course:
Great — let's design your learning program together.

A good course starts with understanding what you want to develop and why — then we'll shape the right content, pace, and sequence around you.

**What are the skills or advisory concepts you'd like to develop?**
